notes.title: 2 years anniversary.
notes.content:
Hello, sumo fans!

We are celebrating 2 years anniversary of Sumoman. We are very happy that after 2 years our game still get a lot of attention and want to announce great discount for our game.

Thank you for playing our game, guys!

Sumoman Team

P.S. By the way, our second game is close to release. Don't forget to add it to your wishlist.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/864160/BEA_Walker/

notes.title: Italian and Brazilian Portugues languages.
notes.content:
Hello, sumo fans!

We have added two new languages: Italian and Brazilian Portuguese. And Sumoman is translated on 18 languages at the moment! It is pretty good achievement for us.

And we keep on working on our next game. It will be the game with more strange controls than in Sumoman. Just look how it will be. 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=M8bN3mrh_1Y

Yep, don't forget to add it to your wishlist, please:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/864160/BEA_Walker/

notes.title: Vietnamese Localization
notes.content:
Hello, sumo fans!

We just have add Vietnamese localization to the game. Honestly, we had Vietnamese localization all the time, but Steam didn't support Vietnamese language  for a while, so we have finished Vietnamese localization only few days ago.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28162398/1e85a1879ba3da20b9a483de5d7d8fee94dc2585.jpg[/img]

Just look how many people helped us with localization of Sumoman. After almost 2 years on Store we have support of 16 languages. Thank you so much, guys. We really appretiate it.

Sumoman team

notes.title: BE-A Walker
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/864160/BEA_Walker/

Hello, Sumo fans!
Thanks for being with us.

We are happy to announce our next game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/864160/BEA_Walker/][b]BE-A Walker[/b]![/url]

It is a side-scroller walking simulator in which you are playing as a pilot of the battle mech called BE-A Walker (Biped Enhanced Assault Walker), defending a human colony from the hordes of savage natives located on Eldorado planet.

We love to experement with gameplay mechanics, so in BE-A Walker will be unusual and interesting controls: raise up one leg, move it to the left or to the right, and then make a step. Repeat it for another one. This is how the walker walks.

Our Sumoman goes to BE-A Walker as a native people of Eldorado. This is how Sumoman transforms to mighty chieftain of savages.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/DS3NQJc.gif[/img]

We plan to release BE-A Walker this August. If you want to support us please visit this page and watch the epic trailer of our upcoming game.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/864160/BEA_Walker/][img]https://store.steampowered.com/gfxproxy/betagfx/apps/864160/header.jpg?t=1526793415[/img][/url]

Best regards,
Sumoman team.

notes.title: Sumoman Update #1
notes.content:
Hello, Sumo fans!

Thanks for being with us.
We just have made our first patch for Sumoman.

[h1]Change log:[/h1]

[list]
[*] Fixed some errors in localization.
[*] Fixed bug, when Sumoman could turn in wrong direction in conversation with NPC.
[*] Fixed quick load algorithm. Some objects could appear in wrong place after quick load on a save point.
[*] Added new save point on level #3 (Run, Sumo! Run!).
[*] Fixed quick load algorithm on level #10 (Down by the river). The raft appears exactly under the hero now, that prevent appearing Sumoman in the water.
[*] Added Alt-F4 combination for rage quit.
[/list]

Best regards,
Sumoman team
